items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: Well, Pud played with Phil Levant, too, I don't know if you ever heard that.

ctx.x: Yeah, Pud played with the, Pud Brown played with the Rice Brothers, he said, and I thought they'd run it.
Well, Pud played with Phil Levant, too, I don't know if you ever heard that. No, I don't know. Extremely popular name band, back in the 30s and 40s. But, Pud's an experienced hand.

He's played with everybody. Yeah, well, there were a lot of, Benny Strickler was a good one who played, like there were those country and western bands and the jazz musician Obscure. Yeah. We talked about so many people. I don't know who the Texas jazzers are. Well, that's a, that's a...
